read: Inflation is re-accelerating, with CPI at 3.7% and unemployment up to 4.20%, while the Fed has raised rates and traders see a December hike as likely. Mortgage rates remain above 7%. A sharp AI-led stock selloff has sent Treasury yields lower; Friday's jobs report is the next test.
